objective: Complete the carbon self-supporting 964/993 monocoque digital twin through native Omniverse review, with English documentation and genuine captures, images and videos.
previous_goal_turn: progress: readable owner frame data acquired, numerically checked and merged in PR519
completion_policy: No phase is complete from a render, placeholder, model output, green software test or missing counterevidence. Preserve measured-interface and professional-review gates.

phases.title: Identity, applicability and road/track approval route
phases.required_exit_evidence: Source-specific donor/body/year/transmission identification and an applicable professional approval/validation plan.
phases.current_observation: C2 is owner-reported; year and gearbox unknown. 993 and C4 need their own interfaces.

phases.title: Acquire and register measured interfaces
phases.required_exit_evidence: Positively identified contact observations, admissible scale/uncertainty, proper common-frame transform, independent off-plane checks, axes/mating faces/holes/tolerances reviewed.
phases.current_observation: 57 documentary entries acquired; 18 source-only spatial checks pass. The screened 23 contours supply no compatible F/G quartet; no donor transform.

phases.title: Reference body torsion/bending denominator
phases.required_exit_evidence: Another accessible reference body or licensed experimental dataset, test fixture/load/angle definitions, calibrated instruments, uncertainty and repeatability.
phases.current_observation: Original donor inaccessible; no accepted physical reference-body test.

phases.title: Validated geometry and model calibration
phases.required_exit_evidence: Traceable central-cell surfaces and interfaces, original-versus-inferred coverage, converged analysis representation and correlation against M2.
phases.current_observation: Assembled underside observations exist. Interior tunnel/upper-cell surfaces and functional interfaces remain incomplete. The old whole-body envelope is rejected.

phases.title: Target and load specification
phases.required_exit_evidence: Filled requirements for mass, torsion/bending, interface loads, dynamic/braking/kerb/restraint cases, fatigue, buckling, thermal/environmental limits and review acceptance.
phases.current_observation: 1200 kg is a vehicle target, not a complete load specification or shell mass. Target/load/allowable gaps remain.

phases.title: Central-cell architecture, laminate and structural simulation
phases.required_exit_evidence: Admitted cell geometry; measured/material-source laminate/core/adhesive/insert properties; load paths; torsion, bending, local joint, buckling/fatigue and agreed crash/restraint analyses with convergence and review.
phases.current_observation: No accepted replacement-cell geometry or composite qualification. Historical isotropic/exploratory results do not transfer.

phases.title: Mould and manufacturing-process simulation
phases.required_exit_evidence: Reviewed tooling splits/demoulding/access, layup/drape, cure/resin/thermal inputs, defects/porosity assumptions, shrinkage/residual-stress studies, machining/inspection and coupon process evidence.
phases.current_observation: Material/process inputs and admitted part/mould geometry are not supplied; no completed manufacturing simulation.

phases.title: Independent engineering review and physical validation plan
phases.required_exit_evidence: Documented professional review of geometry, loads, composite joints/material/process and a correlation/qualification plan before functional release.
phases.current_observation: Software evidence cannot grant structural/road/circuit approval.

phases.title: Traceable final OpenUSD package
phases.required_exit_evidence: Exact geometry-to-USD correspondence, units/axes, resolved dependencies, component/variant identity, linked admitted physics/material/results and validators on the final revision.
phases.current_observation: Observed-underbody workspace exists; historical product scene remains rejected. Linux CPU preflight and synthetic metadata witness pass. Historical stage has 8 AssetValidator failures/6 warnings and 8 generic SimReady requirement failures; final cell and acceptance profile remain open. A later host-cache/default-Foundation loss was observed; fresh private Foundation recovery at its exact revision and Docker witness/profile replay succeeded. The separate host Python remains unavailable.

phases.title: Native Omniverse application verification
phases.required_exit_evidence: NVIDIA runtime execution of the admitted package; complete framing/interior inspection, component selection, save/reopen, reconnect, source-hash preservation and native logs.
phases.current_observation: Linux CPU validation executes in Mac Docker. Mac renderer lacks ovrtx; cached Linux Kit cannot execute on arm64; Kali1 has Intel GPU. Existing Vast inventory does not establish an assigned 964 review host. No new native render or Kit run.

phases.title: English dossier and genuine capture/media delivery
phases.required_exit_evidence: English requirements/evidence/gaps; current native screenshots and render stills/video with camera/frame/runtime metadata and visual inspection. Actual photographs need an actual photographed source/part and rights.
phases.current_observation: English source work and current diagnostic plots exist. Historical rejected-envelope renders do not fulfil final-cell media; no fabricated photographs.

Inspect complete original underbody context for independently identifiable contacts; do not use crop boundaries, width-only matching or mirrored observations.

current_goal_turn: progress: fixed candidate subset rejected reproducibly; real Linux CPU validators executed; full engineering objective remains open
